items.why: Truist raised its price target to $1,000 from $763 and Pivotal raised its target to $930, after Meta launched its Muse Wonder AI models ahead of Oct 21 earnings.
Chip stocks stayed under pressure on AI spending worries and China memory competition, but AMD recovered into positive territory late in the session.
Nvidia steadied after early chip weakness tied to Broadcom CEO comments on AI spending and Microsoft unveiling its Maia 300 inference chip.
Microsoft gained after unveiling its Maia 300 AI chip for inference, pitched as more efficient per megawatt than GPU based systems.

market_note: Big banks are reporting earnings while chip weakness weighs on the Nasdaq.
summary: Stocks were mixed late in the session as earnings season kicked off, chip stocks stayed weak on AI spending worries, and Meta led megacaps higher.
